title: An Infinite Simple Group with Property (T) That Is Sofic and Hyperlinear
summary: Brown asks in 2001 (arXiv:math/0111286, Question 11.7) whether an infinite simple discrete group with Kazhdan's property (T) can embed in the unitary group of an R^ω-embeddable McDuff factor, which for such a group is hyperlinearity; Ozawa asks it in 2003 in that language, in About the QWEP conjecture (arXiv:math/0306067); and Pestov prints it, with the sofic form added, as Open question 9.1 of Hyperlinear and sofic groups: a brief guide (arXiv:0804.3968): can an infinite simple group with Kazhdan's property (T) be hyperlinear, or sofic?
